item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Scale Workloads to Zero with HorizontalPodAutoscaler
item.summary: Kubernetes v1.37 includes API support for horizontal autoscaling of workloads down to zero replicas. This feature is now Beta and enabled by default. item.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports partial indexes
item.summary: Amazon Aurora DSQL now lets you build an index over a specific subset of a table, storing only qualifying rows rather than every row in the entire table, which improves query performance and lowers index storage cost. Many tables hold a small working set alongside a much larger history, such as open orders among years of completed ones. Add a WHERE clause to CREATE INDEX to index just that working set. The index stays small as the table grows, and queries that target those rows read less data. Aurora DSQL uses a partial index for any query whose filter falls within the index's condition....

item.title: Security advisory SW-2026-009: container escape in the Stoneware runtime, fixed in 4.2.2
item.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in the Stoneware container runtime lets a workload with the default configuration read host files outside its mount namespace. Versions 4.0.0 to 4.2.1 are affected. Upgrade to 4.2.2, or apply the published admission policy as a workaround. We have no evidence of exploitation in the wild.

item.title: Advisory TB-2026-003: unsafe deserialization when loading untrusted Tensorbarn checkpoints
item.summary: High severity. Loading a checkpoint from an untrusted source with the default loader can run arbitrary code during deserialization. Fixed in 3.1.0, which switches to a safe tensor format by default. Older checkpoints need a one-time conversion with `tensorbarn convert`. Only deployments that load third-party checkpoints are affected.

item.title: Deprecation notice: Ironvale CLI v1 commands will be removed on March 31, 2027
item.summary: The v1 command set of the Ironvale CLI (iv deploy, iv logs and iv env) is deprecated and will be removed on 31 March 2027. All three have drop-in replacements under iv app. A migration guide and a codemod for CI scripts are available. No action is needed before the end of the year.

item.title: Dunmore retires the embed-v1 embedding model on October 24
item.summary: embed-v1 stops serving requests on 24 October 2026; later calls return HTTP 410. Vectors from embed-v1 are not compatible with embed-v2, so stored embeddings must be regenerated. A batch re-embedding endpoint is available at half price until the shutdown date.
